When I started school, I wanted to become a writer or scientist. Now, I finally found the courage to be just that.

It's scary!

I hold a PhD in Sport and Human Movement Science from the University of Vienna and a BSc degree in Physiotherapy. I have broad interests in training and exercise science for health and performance,

I also feel drawn to psychology and philosophy, even though I have no special training in either. But what can I say - I live in Vienna.

**Embodymate** was originally created in 2015 and developed into a loose collaboration between a Psychotherapist (Chris) and a sport scientist (Peter). Our professional paths diverged a bit, but I keep Embodymate mostly for nostalgic reasons. The name still has meaning to me!

In case you are missing any older content or are interested in psychotherapy, please contact my beloved colleague [Christoph Humnig](https://verhaltenstherapie-ybbsstrasse.jimdosite.com/) directly.
